title: pmx forecast record v1
description: One forecast of one agent on one instrument at one bar, across kinds (CONTRACTS_V2 17.5, ruling R157): on a binary the resolution probability prob_ppm and no horizons; on a continuous instrument one entry per declared horizon with the probability that the price at the horizon exceeds the reference price and, optionally, five price quantiles at QUANTILE_LEVELS_PPM. prob_ppm on a continuous instrument is the up-probability of the shortest horizon, so every consumer of prob_ppm works with no second code path. This is the shape of the hive's forecast payload, of live/forecasts.jsonl and of the horizons field of forecast_recorded.

price_ref_ticks.description: The reference price: the close of the last completed bar at bar_ms (5.4), in ticks; bp on a binary.

allOf.description: A binary forecast has no horizon and its reference is a bp price; a continuous one has at least one horizon.

horizon_forecast.description: One horizon of a continuous forecast. quantiles_ticks carries exactly five prices at QUANTILE_LEVELS_PPM = (100_000, 250_000, 500_000, 750_000, 900_000), non-decreasing, or null when the agent states direction only. The random-walk baseline is up_probability_ppm 500_000 and every quantile equal to price_ref_ticks (ruling R158).
